_metadata.description: Quint-driven verification pipeline: codegen, lint, run-time/check-time freshness and trace replay.

requirements.title: Verify check passes against the template's notes flows
requirements.description: flow-verifier verify check --root templates/scenarios/react-vite finishes ≤ 30s cold and is green on the two notes flows.

validation.notes: Integration test gated by FLOW_VERIFIER_INTEGRATION=1 runs real quint typecheck/test/verify.

requirements.title: CLI parity with the old tool
requirements.description: flows list|validate|new|explain and verify run|check produce byte-identical output and behavior to the deleted tools/temporal-model.

validation.notes: Parity test diffs old vs new generated artifacts before Phase G cutover.

requirements.title: Lint gate is fatal (no --no-lint)
requirements.description: Hand-test replay lint rejects missing imports, missing transition/fixture bindings, and non-top-level runFormalReplay calls. There is no --no-lint flag.
